land_pattern.package: 48-pin LQFP, 7 x 7 mm body, 0.5 mm pitch, JEDEC outline MS-026 BBC
land_pattern.notes: NO RECOMMENDED LAND PATTERN IS PUBLISHED in W5500 Datasheet v1.1.0 - section 7 'Package Descriptions' (Figures 26 and 27) gives only the package OUTLINE, so pad_size_mm, row_spacing_mm and courtyard cannot be grounded from this PDF; use a standard IPC-7351 LQFP-48 0.5 mm (MS-026 BBC) land pattern. Outline dimensions from Figure 26 (min/nom/max, mm): A --/--/1.60 (height), A1 0.05/--/0.15 (standoff), A2 1.35/1.40/1.45, b 0.17/0.22/0.27 (lead width), c 0.09/--/0.20 (lead thickness), D 9.00 BSC and E 9.00 BSC (lead span), D1 7.00 BSC and E1 7.00 BSC (body), e 0.50 BSC (pitch), L 0.45/0.60/0.75 (foot length), L1 1.00 REF, theta 0/3.5/7 deg. Figure 27 repeats these as 9.00 +/-0.20 lead span, 7.00 +/-0.10 body, 0.50 BSC pitch, 0.22 +0.05/-0.06 lead width, 0.80 +/-0.15 foot, 1.60 MAX height, 4 corner chamfers C0.50, 8 x R0.15. Pin 1 is the top-left corner in Figure 1 with a circular dimple; pins run 1-12 down the left side, 13-24 along the bottom, 25-36 up the right side, 37-48 along the top. CAUTION (datasheet comment on p.64): 'W5500 package has changed since Jul2021. The most difference is the hole location on the center of the bottom.' - the circles in Figure 26/27 (phi 1.0 / phi 1.4, and phi 1.20 Dp 0.05 TOP / 2 x phi 1.50 Dp 0.1 max BTM) are mold/ejector holes in the plastic body, NOT an exposed thermal pad.
